matches.rationale: No finding addresses the conditional Gaussian assumption in Section 3.2; the single finding only discusses Theorem 3.5's proof, not Assumption 3.2's validity.

The finding targets the same locus (Theorem 3.5's inequality relating flow-loss and A-optimal objectives) and argues the stated bound/constants are unjustified, undermining the theorem's claimed guarantee — the same substantive defect as GT2, even though it frames the flaw as a proof error rather than an unacknowledged model-approximation gap.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Identifies that Theorem 3.5's claimed relationship between flow-loss and A-optimal objectives lacks valid justification, matching GT2's concern about the theorem's overstated rigor.
